lines.zh: 我的木腿踩得田埂嗒嗒响。
lines.en: My wooden legs clack along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 稻草从我的袖口掉出来。
lines.en: Straw falls out of my sleeve.
I walk the field, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的关节不灵活，走得很僵。
lines.en: My joints are stiff; I walk awkwardly.
I drag one foot, and don't stop.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方倒了几个麦子。
lines.en: A few wheat stalks fall where I pass.
I shuffle toward that patch of shadow.
The wind rocks me once.
I straighten my crooked hat.
Three of my fingers are broken.
I walk from the far end of the field to this one.
I tread a trellis flat and keep going.
I stand in the field with both arms out.
No bird dares land on me.
My mouth is stuffed with old straw.

lines.zh: 我张开的双臂一动不动。
lines.en: My outstretched arms do not move.
A crow circles above.
Rain has soaked my cloth.
This wooden frame is very old.
My shadow is bigger than a bird's.
Insects have nested in me.
I listen to the noises in the field.
I never blink.
I lean, and slowly straighten.
This rope is tied very tight.
It's getting dark, and the field grows colder.
You're standing on my furrow.
I look at you through the wheat ears.

lines.zh: 你手上的镰刀我看见了。
lines.en: I see the sickle in your hand.
I'm not a scarecrow — don't mistake it.

lines.zh: 稻草从我的袖子漏出来。
lines.en: Straw leaks from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的手臂抬到一半就卡住。
lines.en: My arm jams halfway up.
I stand in the field without a sound.
This field is mine to keep.
There is no face under my hat brim.
My brim hides my eyes.
Look at me long enough and I'll move.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我的麦子了。
lines.en: Your shadow is on my wheat.
I've been tied here for years.
I stand here, and I'm not afraid of you.
You knocked that trellis over.
Get back on the ridge.
Only a row of wheat is between us.
The rope at my neck has worked loose.
A handful of my straw falls out.
I lean aside and slowly come back.
The wood creaks once.
You knocked a bit of me loose.
I don't hurt, but I'm not pleased.
I take two stiff steps back.
One of my hands no longer works.
A tear opens in the cloth.
I straighten up and come at you again.
I've stuffed more straw in my mouth.
I'm not here to eat.

lines.zh: 你扔的那东西落在地里。
lines.en: What you threw landed in the field.
Hold that up to my mouth.
I reach out with one hand.
This is no use to me.

lines.zh: 你把谷子放在田埂上吧。
lines.en: Leave the grain on the ridge for me.
Put it closer.
Straw doesn't get hungry.
It landed at my feet.
I nudge the grain closer with my toe.
You bumped into my frame.
I sway badly.
Straw scatters across the ground.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我胸口的麦秆。
lines.en: You knock the straw loose from my chest.
I lean on you; I'm heavy.
My straw is caught on your cuff.
You loosened my rope.
I stepped on you.
I can't steady myself and tip this way.

lines.zh: 稻草从我的断口漏出来。
lines.en: Straw leaks from the break in my frame.
There's another one in the field.
Her arms are out too.

lines.zh: 我们被立在相邻的两垄。
lines.en: We're set up in neighboring rows.
Straw hands sway at the first wind.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只有稻草响。
lines.en: We don't talk; only the straw rustles.
At night her shadow leans over.
A ridge lies between us.
The field is empty this season.
At dawn we stand straight again.
No one will come to untie us.
My hand can only grip a little.
I pick it up with two fingers.
I pinch up a scrap of old cloth.
I lift it and bring it close.
This can go into my chest.
I shake it, and something rattles inside.
I plant it back in the field.
Too heavy; I can't lift it to my waist.
I hold it and keep walking.
I hang it on the frame.

lines.zh: 你走进了不该进的地方。
lines.en: You've walked somewhere you shouldn't.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起钉着木条的手。
lines.en: I slowly raise the hand nailed with slats.
Through the straw seams, I lock on.
You've trampled three rows of wheat.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，很慢，但不会停。
lines.en: I come at you slowly, and I won't stop.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都归我看着。
lines.en: Everything here is mine to watch.
Do you hear the straw rustling?

lines.zh: 我不会让你碰那个架子。
lines.en: I won't let you touch that trellis.
Something inside me is moving.

lines.zh: 稻草扎的身子，也会记仇。
lines.en: A body of straw can hold a grudge.
Backing off won't help, and you're not quick.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的稻草掉了下来。
lines.en: The straw falls out of my mouth.
This rope is half broken.
Everything falls where I step.
This row matters most to me.

lines.zh: 绳子绷紧，我从架子上下来。
lines.en: The rope snaps tight and I step off the frame.

lines.zh: 我的木架一路上吱吱响。
lines.en: My wooden frame creaks with every step.
My arms are held straight out.
Straw keeps dropping from my sleeves.
You're in the middle of my wheat.
I go around by the ridge.
My head stays crooked.
The wind helps, pushing me along.
I'm slow, but I never tire.
Do you hear the wood creaking?
Another step back and you're in the ditch.

lines.zh: 稻草做的我，手一放就散。
lines.en: Straw-bound; lower my arm and it falls apart.

lines.zh: 我站在田边，谁都不敢近。
lines.en: I stand at the field's edge, and nobody comes close.
What are you holding up? I see it.
I point at you with a wooden finger.
All the birds have flown off.
I pause, then continue.

lines.zh: 你踩过的那垄麦子还在响。
lines.en: The wheat you walked through is still rustling.
This whole patch is mine.

lines.zh: 我的袖子挂着麦芒抽过来。
lines.en: A sleeve heavy with wheat awns lashes at you.
Straw scrapes your face.
I jab you with my frame.
I come down on you; I'm heavy.
You're tangled in straw.
Two of my fingers came off.
I swing wide and stumble forward.
You back off, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的稻草手掐住你脖子。
lines.en: My straw hand closes on your throat.
I've caught your sleeve.
The wood splinters loudly.
The recoil knocks me crooked.
I keep reaching for you.
My mouth opens wider.
This time I have you.

lines.zh: 你从我的稻草里挣开了。
lines.en: You pulled free of my straw.
Someone has set me up in the field.
I stand with arms wide, waiting.
The straw is new; the cloth is old.
I woke in this field.
There's a line of prints on the ridge.
I turn my neck, and it creaks.
When the wind comes, I sway.

lines.zh: 有人给我穿上了旧外套。
lines.en: Someone put an old coat on me.
The wheat here isn't ripe yet.
I'm tied to a frame with rope.
Someone is cutting wheat in the distance.
My shadow stood up first.
I smell mud and rain.
I start walking toward the middle of the field.
Someone put this hat on me.
The grass grows fast by my feet.
I open my mouth and test it.
No birds will come tonight.

lines.zh: 我就是干草做的，火一来我就亮。
lines.en: I'm made of dry straw; fire makes me blaze.
I fall and my frame breaks apart.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软了，我抬不起手。
lines.en: Water soaks me soft and I can't lift a hand.

lines.zh: 我被掀飞，稻草撒了整片田。
lines.en: I'm thrown up and straw scatters over the field.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的胸口，卡在木头里。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my chest, stuck in the wood.
That light burns through my cloth.
Straw cannot be eaten, and cannot starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，稻草全竖起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and every straw stands up.

lines.zh: 架子散了，我一路往下落。
lines.en: My frame comes apart and I fall.
